en-US.label: Call Center
en-US.description: Operate Kazoo ACDC queues and agents from one responsive dashboard.
en-US.extended_description: Call Center provides queue configuration, optional internal-extension routing, multi-agent roster management, live agent session controls, current queue and agent statistics, and recent ACDC call outcomes.
features: Create, edit, and delete ACDC queues
Route an optional internal extension to each queue
Assign multiple users to each queue
Login, logout, pause, and resume agents
Review agent performance and recent call outcomes
